headline: Aritra Partners, GameChanger Law, Shardul Amarchand Mangaldas act on Arborum pre-Series fundraise
sum: Arborum Labs Private Limited has raised capital from a pre-series fundraise co-led by Speciale Invest and Ideaspring Capital. Aritra Partners advised Arborum on this fundraise.
detail: Arborum Labs Private Limited has raised capital from a pre-series fundraise co-led by Speciale Invest and Ideaspring Capital. Aritra Partners advised Arborum on this fundraise. GameChanger Law Advisors advised Speciale Invest on this fundraise. The Firm provided end-to-end support comprising legal due diligence, structuring, drafting, reviewing and negotiating the transaction documentation.
